decisions.reason: Restoring the previous root-domain DNS record does not change the marketing site's existing requirement to remain hosted at get.drivereel.example.
The root-domain DNS restoration does not change the selected Webflow Basic hosting plan or its cost-selection rule.
The dealer login destination uses the separate admin subdomain and remains valid regardless of restoration of the root-domain DNS record.
The DNS decision does not alter the contact form's recipient email addresses or lead-delivery behavior.
The source decision concerns root-domain DNS routing and does not change the hero visualization or its depicted product interface.
The occurrence of 'record' in the hero copy is unrelated to a DNS record, so the hero headline and body copy remain unchanged.
Restoring the root-domain DNS record has no necessary effect on the landing page's visual aesthetic, brand assets, or style reference.
